https://taz.de/Die-Wahrheit/!6227554/.title: Die Wahrheit: Haariges aus der Hauptstadt
https://taz.de/Die-Wahrheit/!6227554/.author: Robert Rescue
https://taz.de/Die-Wahrheit/!6227554/.text:
Die Wahrheit: Haariges aus der Hauptstadt
Auch das noch! Berlin hat schlimmste Folgen für menschliche Mähnen.
„Nee, das geht überhaupt nicht“, kommentiert Friseurmeister Pedro Pietsch, nachdem er die Hand unter das laufende Wasser gehalten hat. Er dreht den Wasserhahn zu.
„Das ist absolut Gift für mein Handwerk. Das ist quasi kein Wasser, sondern purer Kalk. Die Leute waschen sich mit dem Berliner Wasser die Haare, dann kommen sie zu mir und ich muss ihnen noch eine Ladung Kalk verpassen. Das verträgt kein Haar. Ich versuche mit Spray und Gel zu retten, was zu retten ist, aber ich kann das Ergebnis auch nur schönreden.“
Das krisengeplagte Berlin ist um eine Katastrophe reicher. Der Hair-Challenge-Index 2026 lässt kein gutes Haar an der Hauptstadt. Nicht nur hohe Mieten, Dreck auf den Straßen, die organisierte Kriminalität und eine abnorm schlechte Gesamtlaune machen das Leben zur Hölle, sondern auch das kalkhaltige Wasser, die Luftverschmutzung, die UV-Strahlung und die Luftfeuchtigkeit.
Diese Faktoren wirken sich auf den Zustand der Haare aus, und weil alles in Berlin zu viel ist, steht es schlecht um das Haupt der Berliner. Das kalkhaltige Wasser ist voll mit Kalzium und Magnesium und diese schlimmen Sachen lagern sich im Haar ab und lassen die Frisur wirken wie sechs Monate nicht gewaschen.
Halber Liter Wasserstoffperoxid
„Apropos schönreden“, erzählt Pietsch. „Eine Weile lang habe ich es mit Wasserstoffperoxid probiert. Ein halber Liter pro Haarwurzel. Die Kunden sahen aus, als hätten sie in eine Steckdose gefasst. Ich habe ihnen erzählt, dass das gerade der letzte Schrei sei, direkt aus Paris und Mailand, das trägt der modebewusste Großstadttrendsetter“, lächelt Pietsch.
„Anfangs glaubten mir die Kunden das noch, aber wenn sie nach zwei Wochen wieder auf der Matte standen und aussahen, als hätte auf ihrem Kopf ein Atombombentest stattgefunden, blieb mir nichts weiter übrig, als ihnen reinen Wein einzuschenken. Berlin ist schuld, bei der Erklärung regt sich gefühlsmäßig bei den meisten nichts mehr. Ich gebe dann halt noch Tipps, wie man vielleicht was retten kann“, schüttelt der Geschundene den Kopf.
„Wegen der UV-Strahlung rate ich zu Sonnencreme, aber halt in die Haare. Die Wohnung nicht zu verlassen, kann auch helfen und wenn sie einen Termin bei mir haben, sollen sie halt eine Mütze tragen oder den Schirm aufspannen. Und bloß kein Wasser! Keine Rohrperle, kein Mineralwasser, kein Tafelwasser. Manche schwören auf Regen und waschen sich dann die Haare. Aber ich weiß nicht, warum sollte in Berlin ausgerechnet das Regenwasser unbedenklich sein?“
Laut dem Hair-Challenge-Index 2026 soll Hamburg von allen deutschen Städten die lebenswerteste sein, was Haare betrifft. Die UV-Strahlung soll die geringste sein, was nicht verwundert, schließlich regnet es dort den ganzen Tag. Vermutlich ist das Leitungswasser auch besser, weil sich das gesamte deutsche Kalkvorkommen in der Region Berlin konzentriert.
In Athen ist Glatze wohl die beste Wahl
Vermutlich ist es weiter im Norden noch besser, während der Süden Europas Werte wie in Berlin erreicht. In Athen beispielsweise dürfte eine Glatze die beste Wahl sein. Das Friseurhandwerk ist dort quasi ausgestorben. Ganzjährige Sonneneinstrahlung, ein Autoverkehr mit einer Feinstaubbelastung jenseits jeglicher Grenzwerte und dann die berühmte Athener Luftfeuchtigkeit, die jeder Frisur eine Festigkeit verleiht, die alle Kämme brechen lässt.
Friseurmeister Pedro Pietsch hat eine Entscheidung getroffen: „Ich glaube, ich wandere nach Hamburg aus. Vielleicht tut die Stadt nicht nur den Haaren gut, wenn Sie verstehen, was ich meine.“
Die Wahrheit auf taz.de
Die Wahrheit
ist die einzige Satire- und Humorseite einer Tageszeitung weltweit.
Die Wahrheit
hat den einzigartigen Cartoonstreifen: ©Tom Touché.
Die Wahrheit
hat drei Grundsätze:
Warum sachlich, wenn es persönlich geht.
Warum recherchieren, wenn man schreiben kann.
Warum beweisen, wenn man behaupten kann.
Deshalb weiß Die Wahrheit immer, wie weit man zu weit gehen kann.

https://taz.de/Reform-der-Fuehrerscheinp.title: Reform der Führerscheinprüfung: Geradezu mörderisch
https://taz.de/Reform-der-Fuehrerscheinp.author: Gereon Asmuth
https://taz.de/Reform-der-Fuehrerscheinp.text:
Reform der Führerscheinprüfung : Geradezu mörderisch
Die Bundesregierung will Kosten und Anforderungen für Führerscheine senken. Dabei liegt die Zukunft im autonomen Fahren – ganz ohne Fahrerlaubnis.
R eformbedarf beim Führerschein? Klar, der besteht. Der Name sollte in Fahrerschein abgeändert werden, damit die bei jeder Diskussion ums Thema aufploppenden Witze mit Verweis auf die deutsche Geschichte – Führer! Hohoho! – ein Ende haben.
Aber die Bundesregierung sieht Handlungsbedarf an anderer Stelle. Sie will den Zugang zum Fahrerschein erleichtern, verbilligen vor allem, damit die Jugend von heute sich auch morgen noch schwungvoll hinters Steuer klemmen kann. Das ist, gelinde gesagt, der völlig falsche Weg. Statt sich fröhlich der Zukunft zuzuwenden, wird wie beim krampfhaften Beharren auf dem Aus vom Verbrenner-Aus an einer Gegenwart festgehalten, die schon bald erkennbar gestrig sein wird. Noch schlimmer: Hier wird mit dem Leben vieler Verkehrsteilnehmer:innen gespielt.
Denn so viel muss klar sein: Autofahren gefährdet Ihre Gesundheit! Vor allem, wenn junge Menschen – genauer gesagt: Männer – am Steuer sitzen, steigt die Zahl der Unfälle. Und die der Unfallopfer. Genau hier die Anforderungen für die Erteilung von Fahrerscheinen abzusenken, ist geradezu mörderisch.
taz debatte
Die taz ist eine unabhängige, linke und meinungsstarke Tageszeitung. In unseren Kommentaren, Essays und Debattentexten streiten wir seit der Gründung der taz im Jahr 1979. Oft können und wollen wir uns nicht auf eine Meinung einigen. Deshalb finden sich hier teils komplett gegenläufige Positionen – allesamt Teil des sehr breiten linken Meinungsspektrums.
Natürlich ist es nachvollziehbar, dass junge Menschen auf einer bezahlbaren Fahrerlaubnis beharren, weil sie ihnen Mobilität und damit Freiheit verspricht. Aber wenn Autofahren zu viel kostet – den einen zu viel Geld, den anderen zu viele Menschenleben –, dann sollte man nicht Prüfungen verbilligen, sondern nach besseren Wegen suchen.
Die liegen auf der Hand: autonom fahrende Autos. Gesteuert von Maschinen, die nicht erst mühsam Verkehrsregeln büffeln müssen, die später missachtet werden. Natürlich verursachen auch die noch Unfälle. Aber so katastrophal selbst überschätzend wie junge Raser können sie niemals sein.
Expert:innen gehen davon aus, dass schon in wenigen Jahren Fahrerlaubnisse allenfalls für Rennstrecken fahrende PS-Fanatiker nötig sein werden. Der Rest glotzt derweil während der Autofahrt ganz entspannt eine coole Serie. Vielleicht über Führer, Fahrer oder andere Oldschool-Typen des 20. Jahrhundert, ohne jemals eine Fahrschule von innen gesehen zu haben. Sicher und billig zugleich.

https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle.title: Experience: I helped jail the teacher who groomed me
https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle.author: Sarah Kopp
https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle.text:
I was 15 when Paul joined my high school in Queensland, Australia, as a PE teacher. He was fun and handsome, and seemed much younger than his 31 years. I was obsessed with dance, and when Paul complimented me on my gymnastics, I was thrilled the “cool” teacher had noticed me.
He’d always stop for a chat. I was the only child of a single mum and though she was there for me, I didn’t confide in her. But he was easy to talk to and I quickly developed a crush.
“You’ve got a muscly bum,” he remarked one day. “I can see it through your shorts.”
I began to wonder if he liked me back. During athletics training he would deliberately step into my path so that I’d collide with him.
Other people were starting to notice Paul’s interest. I denied we were getting close, but rumours kept swirling and he was eventually suspended.
I thought I’d never see him again, but he got someone to pass me his number and asked to meet up. I told Mum I was joining friends and met him at the beach. As we were leaving, he kissed me. It was what I’d been dreaming about, yet it felt wrong. I told myself I just needed to grow up.
One day, I was home sick from school. Knowing Mum was at work, he turned up with chicken soup. At first it seemed romantic, but when Paul started kissing my neck, I froze. My mind drifted away as he led me to the shower. “This is our secret,” he told me.
That was the start of our physical relationship, although we didn’t have sex until I’d turned 16 six months later. By then, Mum knew we were in a relationship. Years later, I asked why she didn’t stop it. She struggles to understand it, but said she didn’t have the confidence to stand up to him and risk alienating me.
Paul found a teaching job in Brisbane and asked me to join him. Mum was desperate not to lose me, so agreed to move, too. When I turned 18, I was relieved to go public as a couple. It was what I’d been waiting for, but neither of us was happy. A year later Paul left and got engaged to someone else, but he was still in contact with me.
When I was 20, he called and told me his relationship was over. Within days we were seeing each other again.
Almost immediately, I got pregnant. I should have felt happy, but I was filled with dread. When Paul proposed – with the same ring he’d given his ex-fiancee – I felt trapped into saying yes. Afterwards, I tiptoed around his bad moods. The only bright spot was the birth of my daughter, when I was 21, followed by my son two years later. I adored being a mum.
Being around other parents for the first time, however, I could see how other relationships worked. They looked nothing like mine. I went to a psychologist, who started talking to me about toxic relationships.
Then I caught Paul talking to another woman, and he moved out. By that time I was 29. Maturity allowed me to look back and see how coercive our relationship had been.
Two years later, we divorced. Part of me wanted to forget all about him. A larger part was more indignant. Paul was still teaching; I had to report him.
In 2018 I made a statement to the police. I was terrified they wouldn’t believe me because I’d married my abuser. To my relief, they recognised I’d been groomed. It took a couple of years for him to be arrested, and then the case went to trial in April 2024. Thankfully, I didn’t have to look at Paul while I testified. I sobbed as the jury found him guilty of indecent treatment of a child.
He was sentenced to two and a half years in prison, but was released in August 2025. Our children are 18 and 20 now, so they understand what he did. Neither speaks to him.
I’d gone back to university to retrain as a dance and drama teacher but wanted to use my experience to help others. I set up a charity, Step in for Kids, to raise awareness of the early stages of grooming.
Mum and I get on well now. I’ve had to work to forgive her, but I don’t blame her. Paul took advantage of both of us. I look at my daughter and it pains me to think what I’d gone through by her age. It makes me more determined to make this world safer for children.
As told to Jacqui Paterson

https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/n.title: Jaguars trounce rudderless Ravens as Baltimore slump to fourth straight loss
https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/n.author: Agencies
https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/n.text:
With their top two quarterbacks injured, the Baltimore Ravens were prepared to use any trick necessary in their attempt to keep the game competitive against Jacksonville. That included snapping the ball directly to Derrick Henry on quite a few occasions.
The Jaguars were ready.
“We practiced Wildcat a ton,” Jacksonville coach Liam Coen said.
Trevor Lawrence threw for 242 yards and a touchdown, and the Jaguars had little trouble with Joe Fagnano and the Ravens in a 33-10 victory. Normally, a Thursday night game presents a preparation challenge for the visiting team, but it was Baltimore who looked like they could have used a longer break with quarterbacks Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley injured.
There was little the Ravens could do but start Fagnano, a 25-year-old rookie who made his debut last weekend against Buffalo. He threw for only 60 yards against the Jags. Baltimore (4-5) have lost four straight.
With their top two quarterbacks on injured reserve – and Fagnano dealing with an ankle issue – the Ravens now await Jacoby Brissett’s arrival as they try to prevent their season from falling apart completely.
“Tough situation for our guys. But I just told them, there’s no excuses,” Baltimore coach Jesse Minter said. “There’s no, ‘Whatever, we don’t have this guy, we don’t have that guy.’”
Jacksonville (6-2) did not need to do anything extraordinary to beat a badly weakened Baltimore team. The Jaguars mostly took care of the ball on a rainy night and avoided any extreme risks. The Jags have won five of their last six to take command of the AFC South, where they have a three-and-a-half-game lead.
Jacksonville drove 77 yards on the game’s first possession, taking a 7-0 lead on a one-yard touchdown run by Bhayshul Tuten.
“That opening drive was huge, just to set the tone,” Lawrence said. “Especially when you get the ball first ... that’s something that’s important, is to be able to go and get points right away.”
The Ravens tried to be creative, repeatedly running Wildcat-style plays with Henry. Baltimore managed a field goal on their first drive but nothing more until late in the game.
It was still close near the end of the first half, but Lawrence found Parker Washington for a 50-yard touchdown pass with 58 seconds left in the second quarter. That made it 17-3 at half-time.
“I just think he was very on when it was really a game,” Coen said of Lawrence. “When it was mattering and things were going and it’s a back-and-forth football game early on, he was extremely sharp, accurate and played, again, a really solid football game for us.”
It was 20-3 when a fumble gave Baltimore the ball at midfield in the third quarter, but the Ravens immediately turned the ball over on downs and boos came cascading down from the crowd.
“They have every right to boo or do whatever they want to do. Obviously, us in here, we have to stay together, be on one accord, and just keep on relying on each other,” tight end Mark Andrews said. “You’ve got to be there for your brother. And that’s what we’re going to do is keep it in house and continue to fight for one another. And we’ll see how this thing shakes out.”
Fagnano went 10 of 18 with two second-half interceptions. Baltimore also lost a fumble on a kick return, which led to Chris Rodriguez Jr’s two-yard touchdown run with 7:26 left in the game that made it 33-3.
Justice Hill broke free for a 65-yard touchdown run 11 seconds later – Baltimore’s first touchdown after half-time since Week 5. Hill finished with 85 yards on nine carries, snapping Jacksonville’s 24-game streak of not allowing a 75-yard rusher.
It is the first time in franchise history the Ravens have lost three straight games by at least 20 points. In 2015, Baltimore were routed 35-6 by Seattle and 34-14 by Kansas City in consecutive weeks, but the Ravens won the game after that.
Baltimore lost 35-13 to Cincinnati and 36-10 to Buffalo before Thursday’s game.
In addition to their problems at quarterback, the Ravens were without starting cornerback Nate Wiggins, who had been listed with an illness earlier in the week.
Baltimore also lost star safety Kyle Hamilton to a hip injury.

https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/n.title: LSU thrash Texas Southern by school-record 109 points in historic 131-22 rout
https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/n.author: Agencies
https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/n.text:
Jada Williams scored 16 of her 18 points in the second quarter and No 9 LSU scored 40 unanswered points in the period on the way to a school-record margin of victory in a 131-22 win over Texas Southern on Thursday night.
LSU (2-0) outscored Texas Southern 40-0 in the quarter, forcing nine turnovers and holding the visiting Tigers without a field goal in 13 attempts.
The 109-point victory was a program record. It was LSU’s second straight 100-plus-point game to start the season and the Lady Tigers improved to 7-0 all-time against Texas Southern (0-2).
The margin was also the largest in NCAA women’s basketball history in a game between two Division I opponents, according to ESPN Insights.
Williams, a transfer from Iowa State, was among a group of seven players who scored in double figures. Freshman Anna Minaeva scored 21 points, Mikaylah Williams added 20, ZaKiyah Johnson 17, Grace Knox and MiLaysia Fulwiley contributed 15 each and Lola Lampley finished with 10.
Williams was scoreless in the first quarter but made six of seven shots, including three three-pointers, in eight minutes of the second quarter. Fulwiley and Knox added six apiece.
Mikaylah Williams’ three-pointer, the fourth of the quarter, accounted for LSU’s 65-13 lead at the break.
Jayla Cornelius’ six points led Texas Southern, who shot 13% (8-for-55) and turned the ball over 38 times, enabling LSU to outscore TSU 55-0 in points off turnovers.
LSU presented flowers to former All-American Angel Reese, who helped the Lady Tigers to their first national championship in 2023. Reese was this year’s WNBA defensive player of the tear and was part of the Atlanta Dream team that reached the finals and came within a single win of the team’s first ever championship.

https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live.title: US midterm elections 2026 live: all eyes on last two razor-thin Senate races as Democrats vie to expand blue wave
https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live.author: Shrai Popat (now): Taz Ali and Adam Fulton (earlier)
https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live.text:
Colom leads Republican incumbent by 1,800 votes in nail-biting US Senate race in Mississippi
Democrat Scott Colom, a district attorney, is leading Republican incumbentCindy Hyde-Smith by a little more than 1,800 votes in the shockingly competitive US Senate race in Mississippi.
As of now 96% of the vote has been counted, but the Associated Press has yet to call the contest. Mississippi law that allows mail-in ballots to be counted as long as they are postmarked by, and received within five business days of the election. This means we might not get the final result until early next week.
If Colom wins, it would be an astonishing defeat of a senator who is serving her first full-term, in a state where a Democrat hasn’t won a US Senate seat since 1982. Colom would also be the first Black senator from Mississippi since the Reconstruction Era, after the Civil War. Trump won the Magnolia state by 22 points in 2024.
Another Trump loyalist resigns from justice department as Democrats prepare oversight
Jason Reding Quiñones, a fierce ally of Donald Trump and the US attorney for the Southern District of Florida, has resigned from the justice department.
He announced his departure on social media, thanking Donald Trump for his “trust”. The outgoing prosecutor notably launched an investigation into intelligence officials who launched an inquiry into how Russia boosted Trump in the 2016 presidential election. This despite the fact that ex-FBI and intelligence officials were investigated and effectively exonerated by two special counsels and a Republican-led Senate panel.
Quiñones’ departure comes just a day after Todd Blanche, the attorney general, announced that Harmeet Dhillon, the justice department lawyer who led the Civil Rights division, had resigned. Dhillon was the first high-ranking justice department official to leave after the midterm elections in which Democrats took control of Congress. Democrats are expected to use that power to aggressively investigate executive agencies, including the justice department.
Federal judge temporarily halts building work on Trump’s triumphal arch
Michael Sainato
A federal judge in the early hours of Friday blocked any construction work from beginning on Donald Trump’s towering triumphal arch for 14 days, a major setback for one of the president’s most prominent projects in his vision to remake the nation’s capital.
The temporary restraining order was issued by US district judge Tanya Chutkan in a Washington DC court that has regularly proved to be a thorn in the US president’s side, such as in previous cases involving election subversion and the January 6 insurrection by Trump supporters.
The new ruling followed a series of steps taken on Thursday by the government, including the final approval of the 250ft-high (76 meter) arch by the National Capital Planning Commission in an 8-4 vote after a nine-hour hearing where dozens of witnesses opposed the construction.
The arch is one of several projects around Washington that Trump has undertaken as he remakes the city, from renovating one of its storied public golf courses to threatening to demolish the John F Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts. Those projects could soon face greater scrutiny after the Democrats gained control of Congress.

This means we might not get the final result until early next week.
If Colom wins, it would be an astonishing defeat of a senator who is serving her first full-term, in a state where a Democrat hasn’t won a US Senate seat since 1982. Colom would also be the first Black senator from Mississippi since the Reconstruction Era, after the Civil War. Trump won the Magnolia state by 22 points in 2024.
Today, our team of Guardian political reporters will also be answering your questions about the historic blue wave that swept through these midterm elections.
We’ll dig in to how Democrats managed to pull off this seismic win for control of Congress, and what’s next for the party and for Donald Trump.
Flávio Bolsonaro, the far-right politician who lost Brazil’s presidential election last month, has insisted his defeat is not “the end for Brazil” as he battles to maintain political relevance after fleeing to the US.
Bolsonaro absconded early last week shortly after losing the 25 October election to the leftwing incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva by more than 4m votes.
On Thursday night Bolsonaro made his first major public appearance since arriving in the US, speaking at a rightwing gathering at Donald Trump’s Mar-a-Lago property where he claimed “great things” were still to come.
“I know this wasn’t the end for Brazil and I know it wasn’t the end for America,” Bolsonaro, 45, told a gala dinner at the Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC)’s four-day “gathering of visionaries” event, where the former British prime minister Liz Truss is also due to speak.
“Even when what seems like the end isn’t what we’d hoped for, we must thank God and have even more faith that this isn’t yet the end,” he added. “No one shuts the door that he opens – and the door he shuts, no one opens.”
Earlier, in his first post-election interview, Bolsonaro made a series of unsubstantiated claims about election fraud and insisted he received “help from absolutely no one” to flee.
“It was all me,” Bolsonaro told the New York Times, contradicting reports that he was helped by the Trump adviser Jason Miller and Santiago Caputo, a close aide to Argentina’s rightwing president, Javier Milei.
He said he would “take to the grave” the full story of how he had fled Brazil, where he faces federal police investigations for money laundering and corruption. Bolsonaro is a member of congress who has held elected office for more than 20 years but he will lose parliamentary immunity early next year when his term ends, meaning he could then be prosecuted.
Donald Trump will begin the day in Washington today.
He has closed door meetings for much of the day, and will take part in a Diwali celebration at the White House at 1:30pm ET. While that’s currently not open to the press we’ll let you know if that opens up.
Trump will then head to Cape Canaveral, Florida, for remarks at the Kennedy Space Center at 6pm ET. We’ll bring you the latest as that gets going.
The US jobs report shows that employers added 165,000 jobs in October – a significant increase, defying expectations. Meanwhile, the unemployment rate saw a slight drop to 4.1%.
US report expected amid global stock market tumble
The Bureau of Labor Statistics is set to release the latest US jobs report at 8.30am ET today. Analysts have predicted a slight increase in October job numbers, while predicting that unemployment will stay around 4.2%.
A reminder that the last report before the midterm elections saw US employers add only 29,000 jobs in September, a sharp drop from August’s gains, and unemployment rose slightly.
European stock markets have fallen sharply as a rout in US tech stocks spread across the Atlantic, after the Democrats’ midterms victory sparked fears of a slowdown in the AI industry.
A sell-off on Wall Street on Thursday was followed by sharp falls in Asian stocks markets on Friday morning. The investor sentiment then reached London, where the market is poised for its worst day since March.
The FTSE 100 index, which tracks blue-chip shares listed in London, was down 207 points, or 1.9%, at 10,575 points in mid-morning trading.
Germany’s Dax index fell by 1.9% in morning trading, France’s Cac 40 dropped by 1.5% and Spain’s Ibex lost 1.1%.
Susannah Streeter, the chief investment strategist at Wealth Club, said: “The tech sell-off has intensified, with the pain of the brutal sell-off on Wall Street carried straight through to Asia and knocking sentiment in Europe.
“Big worries are colliding – the build-out of datacentres looks set to slow, which risks shredding the spending spree underpinning the boom, right at the time that investors have become super nervous about returns on this massive investment.”
Trump champions AI 'superintelligence' as investors fret over sector’s future
Meanwhile, Donald Trump has issued a statement on his Truth Social app calling on US states to embrace artificial intelligence (AI), or “superintelligence” as he prefers to call it, arguing that those which attract AI companies, data centres and investment stand to become enormously wealthy. As my colleague Graeme Weardenwrites, global markets have been rattled by a Wall Street selloff in AI-related stocks, amid concerns that the prospect of tighter regulation following the US midterm elections could add to worries over the sector’s mounting debt and spending.
Trump wrote:
As President, I am 100% in favor of Super Intelligence (SI), and will work with the many States in the U.S. that want to become RICH by having them. They are GOLD, and only foolish leadership will say “NO” to the riches they bring!”
His comments followed an earlier all-caps post in which he declared:
I JUST WASN’T ON THE BALLOT. IF I WERE, WE WOULD HAVE WON IN A LANDSLIDE!”
Tuesday night’s explosive rout of the Republican party was supercharged by the fury of Hispanic Americans who turned out in record numbers in key battlegrounds to protest the Trump administration’s anti-immigrant assault on their communities.
“Trump went against us,” said Benny Melendez from Weslaco, Texas. “He made us the target of ICE operations, so we decided to punish him by voting against his party. That’s what happened.”
Melendez, the owner of a small housebuilding company in south Texas, voted for Donald Trump in the presidential election two years ago, attracted by his promise to secure the Mexican border and improve the economy. But on Tuesday, he cast his vote for the Democrats in a display of pure anger.
Two of his cousins and up to 15 of his building workers have been picked up and deported to Mexico by ICE. When Melendez voted for Trump in 2024 he expected the immigration raids would focus on those with criminal records, he said, not his relatives and employees.
“They’re taking our neighbors. They’re taking our friends. They’re they’re taking our workers, and they’re taking our family members. This is an attack against our community.”
Melendez’s rage, replicated in the millions across Texas, Florida and other critical swing states, itself tells a story. It speaks to how Trump first wooed, and then alienated, the backing of many Latino voters, effectively shooting himself in the foot.
Following a difficult set of midterm results for the Republican party, Donald Trump has spent much of this week talking up his renovation projects in Washington. Thursday brought the first official action of his post-midterms presidency – a proclamation designating the gold-adorned Oval Office and Cabinet Room as a national monument.
With the dust still settling on the midterms, attention is already turning to the Republicans who might seek to lead the party into the next presidential race in 2028. JD Vance, Ted Cruz and Ron DeSantis are among those in the mix, as the Republican party begins to reckon with the fallout from its midterms performance.
In this report, my colleague Ariana Baiolooks at the early jockeying, the potential contenders and what the midterm results could mean for the party’s future:
All eyes on last two razor-thin Senate races as Democrats vie to expand blue wave
Welcome to our live coverage of the US midterm elections – here are some of the latest key developments.
A number of closely watched contests in the midterms are still to be called, including the final two US Senate races – in Mississippi and Alaska. The Democratic candidates are hoping to oust Republican incumbents to bolster their new majority in Congress. Right now, Democrats have a 106-seat majority in Congress as we await final results.
Democrats flipped another eight House seats, strengthening their majority in the lower chamber. Democrats are now leading Republicans 253 to 157, with 25 races left to call, as a number of GOP representatives felt the weight of the blue wave that has swept their party out of power. Republicans held on to two House seats in the west as congressman Mike Kennedy won re-election in Utah and Amanda McKinney won in Washington.
Democratic socialist Nithya Raman was elected to serve as the mayor of Los Angeles, eking out a narrow win over incumbent Karen Bass, in a major shake-up in local politics that reflects the growing dissatisfaction with the direction of the city. The progressive urban planner had served on LA’s city council since 2020.
Harmeet Dhillon, a key Trump ally, resigned from her position leading the justice department’s Civil Rights division. Attorney general Todd Blanche said he accepted her notice. Dhillon is the first high-ranking justice department official to leave after the midterm elections. Democrats are expected to use their power in taking control of Congress to aggressively investigate executive agencies, including the justice department.
Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic senator-elect in Michigan, said the new majority in the upper chamber needed “action” from their leader. On the campaign trail El-Sayed refused to back Senator Chuck Schumer, who currently serves as the minority leader. Speaking to CNN, El-Sayed reiterated that Senator Chris Van Hollen, the Maryland Democrat, would be an “amazing Senate majority leader”, but didn’t completely rule out supporting Schumer.
Joining the chorus of Republicans who blasted their party’s midterms performance is Senator Ted Cruz of Texas, who said the GOP were handed an “ass-kicking” in losing control of Congress. “It was not simply a bad 2006 midterm election, it was a Watergate-level repudiation,” he said on his podcast.
The Nasdaq share index had its worst day in 19 months after slumping 5.5% on Thursday amid growing signs the artificial intelligence industry will face tougher regulation because of the midterm results.
Donald Trump signed a proclamation that preserves the Oval Office and Cabinet Room as national monuments in his first official action after the Republican wipeout.

A 72ª Feira do Livro de Porto Alegre segue até 15 de novembro, na praça da Alfândega, no Centro Histórico, com programação gratuita das 10h às 20h, lançamentos, debates, sessões de autógrafos e atividades para todos os públicos. Em 2026, o tema é “Essência que faz histórias” e a patrona é a escritora, antropóloga e educadora Heloisa Pires Lima. Além da praça da Alfândega, a programação se espalha por espaços como o Clube do Comércio e o Teatro Petrobras Carlos Urbim. A programação completa pode ser consultada no site oficial do evento.
Confira uma seleção de atividades da Feira do Livro de Porto Alegre:
Editora Coragem lança ‘Os ditadores latino-americanos’ e ‘A máquina cultural’
Os tradutores Fábio B. Pinto e Karina Lucena debatem as obras “Os ditadores latino-americanos”, do uruguaio Ángel Rama (1926-1983), e “A máquina cultural”, da argentina Beatriz Sarlo (1942-2024), com mediação do professor Luís Augusto Fischer. O primeiro analisa romances de Miguel Ángel Asturias, Gabriel García Márquez, Augusto Roa Bastos e Alejo Carpentier para pensar as figuras que concentraram todo o poder em si. O segundo examina, a partir do caso argentino, o papel de professoras, tradutoras e vanguardistas nos mecanismos culturais da América Latina.
Serviço
Data: 6 de novembro (sexta-feira), às 14h
Local: Sala dos Jacarandás, 2º andar do Clube do Comércio, rua dos Andradas, 1085, Porto Alegre
Hamilton Vaz Pereira autografa ‘De letra: livro de folhas soltas’
Fundador do grupo Asdrúbal Trouxe o Trombone, que renovou a cena teatral carioca nos anos 1970, o dramaturgo, diretor e ator Hamilton Vaz Pereira lança “De letra: livro de folhas soltas”, sua primeira obra de ficção. O livro reúne histórias e personagens que se cruzam como folhas ao vento, entre encontros amorosos, artistas, milicianos e absurdos cotidianos. Antes dos autógrafos, o autor conversa com o jornalista Roger Lerina.
Serviço
Data: 6 de novembro (sexta-feira), às 18h (bate-papo) e às 19h (autógrafos)
Local: Sala Vitrine de Lançamento, Clube do Comércio, rua dos Andradas, 1085, 2º andar (bate-papo), e Praça de Autógrafos, praça da Alfândega, s/n (autógrafos), Porto Alegre
Maria Helena Weber lança o romance ‘Entre marés’
A escritora, professora e pesquisadora Maria Helena Weber lança “Entre marés” (Libretos Editora, 188 páginas), romance que acompanha, ao longo de décadas, os encontros e desencontros de três personagens, Matteo, Chiara e Caetana, entre o Brasil e a Itália. A presidenta da Fundação José Saramago, Pilar del Río, destaca a habilidade da autora na construção de personagens movidos por desejos e contradições.
Serviço
Data: 7 de novembro (sábado), às 17h (bate-papo) e às 18h (autógrafos)
Local: Sala Vitrine de Lançamento, Clube do Comércio, rua dos Andradas, 1085, 2º andar (bate-papo), e Praça de Autógrafos, praça da Alfândega, s/n (autógrafos), Porto Alegre
Aliança Francesa leva contação de histórias e concerto de cordas à Feira
A Aliança Francesa Porto Alegre mantém um estande na Feira até 15 de novembro, com coleção de obras francófonas em português para leitura no local. No sábado, a escritora Rosane Castro conta “Histórias que vêm de longe”, com narrativas de povos que têm o francês como língua de expressão. No domingo, o Conjunto de Cordas Aliança Francesa, formado por sete músicos da Orquestra Jovem da Orquestra Sinfônica de Porto Alegre (Ospa), apresenta canções que vão de trilhas de cinema a sucessos francófonos, como “Le Festin”, “Amour plastique”, “Balance ton quoi” e “Dernière danse”.
Serviço
Data: 7 de novembro (sábado), às 16h30 (contação), e 8 de novembro (domingo), às 18h (concerto)
Local: Porto das Histórias Sulgás, praça da Alfândega (dia 7), e Teatro Petrobras Carlos Urbim, avenida Sepúlveda, entre o Museu de Arte do Rio Grande do Sul (Margs) e o Memorial do Rio Grande do Sul (dia 8), Porto Alegre
Celso Gutfreind e Martina Schreiner lançam ‘A bruxa Carmela’
Celso Gutfreind lança “A bruxa Carmela” (Libretos Editora), com ilustrações de Martina Schreiner. Na história, Carmela, amiga de outras duas bruxas dos livros anteriores do autor, ajuda um menino quietinho a encontrar seu caminho, a pedido da fada. Segundo a divulgação, a obra também pode ajudar crianças que se encontram em algum ponto do espectro do autismo ou que apresentam dificuldade relacionada à subjetividade. Escritor e médico, com especialização em psiquiatria infantil e doutorado em psicologia pela Universidade Paris 13, Gutfreind tem 58 livros publicados. “Acredito muito no poder de ouvir e contar histórias para vermos um mundo melhor”, diz o autor.

Data: 7 de novembro (sábado), às 14h (bate-papo com o autor e a ilustradora) e às 15h (autógrafos)
Local: Porto das Histórias, área infantil (bate-papo), e Praça de Autógrafos (autógrafos), praça da Alfândega, Porto Alegre
Assis Brasil celebra 50 anos de ‘Um quarto de légua em quadro’ com edição especial
O escritor Luiz Antonio de Assis Brasil participa de painel com o professor Luís Augusto Fischer sobre a edição comemorativa de 50 anos de “Um quarto de légua em quadro”, seu primeiro romance. A nova edição tem capa dura e arte que destaca o Monumento aos Açorianos, em Porto Alegre. A narrativa reúne os relatos do diário do médico açoriano Gaspar de Fróis sobre a travessia do Atlântico e a chegada ao sul do Brasil entre 1752 e 1753.

Data: 8 de novembro (domingo), às 15h (painel) e às 16h (autógrafos)

Alê Primo lança ‘Eu sou ela’, seu primeiro livro
Em “Eu sou ela: O que aprendi com minha transição de gênero aos 51 anos” (Editora Sulina, 224 páginas), a professora titular da Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS) Alê Primo narra a infância, a revelação a amigos e colegas, o título de Miss Universe Trans Brasil (Ladies) e o preconceito que descobriu após a transição. A segunda parte, “Transvivência”, une ciência, filosofia e experiência pessoal para refletir sobre identidade e corpo.

Data: 8 de novembro (domingo), às 16h
Local: Praça de Autógrafos da Feira do Livro, praça da Alfândega, s/n, Porto Alegre
Evento ‘Humor em tempos de cólera’ reúne leitura de textos e lançamento de ‘Sem pé nem cabeça’
Com direção de Marina Lopes, o evento “Humor em tempos de cólera: o riso contra a barbárie” traz a leitura de textos humorísticos da literatura brasileira, intercalada com a declamação de poemas de “Sem pé nem cabeça – poemas-pílula” (Editora Parangolé, 96 páginas), de Breno Serafini e Luís Augusto Lopes. O livro reúne micropoemas sobre o cotidiano, com humor e picardia. O encerramento tem canja musical de Jottagá, da banda Froide Explica.

Taiasmin Ohnmacht lança ‘Cartas para uma professora’, ambientado em Porto Alegre pós-enchentes
Escritora e psicanalista Taiasmin Ohnmacht lança livro com ilustrações de Mitti Mendonça | Crédito: Divulgação
A escritora e psicanalista Taiasmin Ohnmacht lança “Cartas para uma professora” (Libretos Editora, 168 páginas), com ilustrações de Mitti Mendonça. Narrada por João Francisco e por sua professora, Jussara, a história se revela por meio de cartas e acompanha dois adolescentes da Restinga que percorrem bairros da cidade em uma jornada que começa como busca pelo pai e se transforma na descoberta da necessidade coletiva de reencantar Porto Alegre. Os elementos mágicos partem de lendas e crenças de cada região e de referências da religiosidade de matriz africana.

Álvaro Santi lança ‘Banda Municipal de Porto Alegre – História, Música e Cultura’
O escritor e músico Álvaro Santi lança “Banda Municipal de Porto Alegre – História, Música e Cultura”, fruto de oito anos de pesquisa sobre a corporação criada em 1925. No processo, ele catalogou mais de 700 títulos das partituras que formaram o repertório da banda entre 1926 e 1963. O lançamento tem bate-papo com o autor e Eliseu Rodrigues, com tradução em Língua Brasileira de Sinais (Libras), apresentação musical de T. Carlos Urbim e sessão de autógrafos.

Malu Baumgarten lança ‘Minhas águas’, coletânea de 31 poemas
“Minhas águas” (Selo Invencionática/Editora Bestiário, 116 páginas) tem apresentação de Cláudia Chigres e orelha de Micheliny Verunschk. Dividido em seis partes, o livro usa a água como fio condutor e traz 20 fotografias, 18 delas da própria autora, com paisagens do litoral gaúcho e catarinense e de Toronto, no Canadá, onde ela vive.

Artur Barcelos apresenta ‘As Missões jesuíticas e o Rio Grande Guarani’
O historiador e arqueólogo Artur Barcelos apresenta “As Missões jesuíticas e o Rio Grande Guarani”, em conversa com Luís Augusto Fischer. O livro, publicado originalmente como série da Revista Parêntese, do Grupo Matinal Jornalismo, entende as Missões como parte da longa história guarani, anterior e posterior à presença jesuítica, e questiona interpretações tradicionais. A obra tem posfácio do historiador guarani Laércio Karai e do professor argentino Carlos Daniel Paz.

Data: 11 de novembro (quarta-feira), às 16h (bate-papo) e às 17h (autógrafos)

Michelle Aparecida Marques dos Santos lança ‘Cicatrizes da Rua’
“Cicatrizes da Rua” (Libretos Editora, 120 páginas) é o relato autobiográfico de Michelle Aparecida Marques dos Santos, que viveu a adolescência nas ruas, enfrentou a dependência química e perdeu a guarda dos filhos. Hoje, além de escritora, ela é padeira do Clube de Pães Amada Massa e facilitadora social do projeto Todos na Rua, e há mais de duas décadas integra o jornal Boca de Rua. A apresentação é da escritora Lilian Rocha, curadora da literatura negra na Feira. Segundo Santos, o livro busca alertar jovens e adolescentes sobre a dificuldade de sair do mundo das drogas.

Richard Serraria lança ‘Hábito de pássaro é o céu’ e participa de bate-papo sobre poesia amefricana

Cátia Castilho Simon lança o livro de contos ‘O Pássaro de Ontem’
“O Pássaro de Ontem” (Caravana Grupo Editorial) reúne 13 contos que, segundo a apresentação de Dani Langer, mostram como o passado histórico de colonização e catequese segue em curso sobre corpos de mulheres, negros e indígenas. O livro foi lançado na Festa Literária Internacional de Paraty, em Buenos Aires e em Paris.

Everton Gullar lança ‘Ópera dos Dias Contados’ e autografa na Feira
O escritor Everton Gullar, natural de Carazinho e radicado em Lajeado, faz o lançamento oficial de “Ópera dos Dias Contados” (Editora Cinco Gatas, 170 páginas), seu segundo livro, com sessão de autógrafos. O romance, de realismo fantástico, acompanha Morana, uma mulher que atravessa um período de desorientação e encontra, em uma amizade inesperada, o ponto de partida para uma transformação pessoal. Ao longo da história, a personagem confronta angústias, traumas e frustrações e reconhece outras mulheres que compartilham experiências semelhantes. O autor estreou com “Sociedade dos Corpos Não Reclamados”, lançado de forma independente em 2025. Para Gullar, “estar em um evento tão importante para a literatura gaúcha permite que a minha história e o meu trabalho encontrem novas pessoas”.

Paulo Paim autografa ‘Política com Alma’ e distribui exemplares gratuitos
O senador Paulo Paim (PT) autografa “Política com Alma” (Editora do Senado Federal, 246 páginas), que reúne reflexões sobre política, ação legislativa, justiça social, direitos humanos e os desafios do Brasil. O livro apresenta o pensamento do parlamentar sobre o papel da política na construção de uma sociedade mais justa, solidária e democrática. Exemplares serão distribuídos gratuitamente ao público durante o evento.

‘Clicky Ponting’ handed two-year suspension over cricket cheating scandal
Amateur cricketer caught clicking his fingers while fielding to trick umpire into thinking the batsman had edged the ball.
The English amateur cricketer who went viral for finger-clicking trickery has been handed a two-year suspension, the North Yorkshire and South Durham Cricket League has said.
The fielder Brian Devine, dubbed “Clicky Ponting” on social media in a nod to former Australia captain Ricky Ponting, was accused of tricking umpires by clicking his fingers to make the sound of a ball nicking the bat as deliveries were missed and caught by the wicketkeeper.
The video footage went viral on social media and made international headlines earlier this year. A three-person disciplinary panel reviewed the footage and considered player interviews and written statements before imposing the ban.
“The player concerned is suspended from all cricket under the ECB’s [the England and Wales Cricket Board] jurisdiction for two years, from 30 September 2026 to 29 September 2028. This covers playing, coaching, umpiring, scoring and managing junior teams,” the NYSDL said in a statement on Friday.
Additionally, Saltburn Cricket Club have been fined 300 pounds ($402.87) and their second XI has been relegated to Division Three of the NYSDCL and will start the 2027 season with a 60-point deduction, the league added.
Devine and Saltburn admitted the charges, but the club appealed against their sanction.
Saltburn said in a statement reported on gazettelive.co.uk: “The club fully participated in the disciplinary proceedings and accept the decision of the appeal following the original decision from the league.”
In a statement to the Press Association, the league said, “The league recognises the strain this has placed on many people, especially those who were abused online and in person.
“We ask everyone to respect that the formal process is now complete. The league will make no further comment.”
Ricky Ponting, who led Australia to two 50-over World Cup titles, told the Reuters news agency that he found the controversy amusing, although he was less impressed that his name had become associated with the player.
“I had a bit of a chuckle to myself and pretty much forgot about it after that,” he said in an interview earlier this year.
“I guess it wasn’t a nice thing to have my name associated with someone who’s blatantly cheating but … honestly I had a laugh and a joke about it.”

O Exame Nacional do Ensino Médio (Enem) 2026 mobiliza mais de cinco milhões de inscritos em todo o país nos domingos 8 e 15 de novembro. Para evitar sobressaltos e garantir o cumprimento das regras oficiais, o Instituto Nacional de Estudos e Pesquisas Educacionais (Inep) e o Ministério da Educação (MEC) divulgaram o guia prático com os horários de aplicação, a documentação aceita e a lista de itens permitidos e proibidos.
Cronograma oficial de horários
Todas as etapas do exame seguem rigorosamente o horário oficial de Brasília. Os participantes devem atentar para o cumprimento dos prazos para não perderem a prova:
12h: Abertura dos portões. O Inep recomenda a chegada dos candidatos a partir deste horário para a localização da sala e conferência de dados com tranquilidade.
13h: Fechamento dos portões. O acesso aos locais de prova é encerrado impreterivelmente às 13h.
13h às 13h30: Período destinado aos procedimentos de segurança, identificação na porta das salas, desligamento de eletrônicos e guarda de pertences no envelope porta-objetos.
13h30: Início da aplicação das provas em todo o país.
15h30: Horário a partir do qual o candidato pode deixar a sala de prova em definitivo, mas sem o caderno de questões.
Término das provas no 1º domingo (8 de novembro): Encerramento às 19h (duração de 5 horas e 30 minutos para a resolução das 45 questões de Linguagens, 45 de Ciências Humanas e a Redação). Os participantes podem sair com o caderno de questões a partir das 18h30.
Término das provas no 2º domingo (15 de novembro): Encerramento às 18h30 (duração de cinco horas para a resolução das 45 questões de Ciências da Natureza e 45 de Matemática). A saída com o caderno de provas é permitida a partir das 18h.
Candidatos com direito a tempo adicional aprovado pelo Inep podem permanecer na prova por mais uma hora, com encerramento às 20h no primeiro domingo e às 19h30 no segundo.
Documentos de identificação autorizados
A apresentação de documento oficial com foto e dentro da validade é obrigatória. Sem um documento válido, o candidato fica impedido de realizar o exame.
São aceitos como documentos físicos a Carteira de Identidade (RG ou CIN), a Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH), o Passaporte, a Carteira de Trabalho impressa (emitida após 27 de janeiro de 1997) e a carteira de identificação expedida por conselho de classe.
Para os documentos digitais, são aceitos exclusivamente o e-Título, CNH Digital, RG Digital ou Identidade Digital (CIN), desde que apresentados diretamente no aplicativo oficial correspondente ou no aplicativo Gov.br. Não são aceitas capturas de tela (prints), fotos da tela do celular, arquivos salvos fora dos aplicativos oficiais ou documentos digitais sem foto.
Também não são aceitos boletins de ocorrência, certidões de nascimento ou casamento, título de eleitor impresso, carteiras de estudante, crachás ou cópias de documentos, ainda que autenticadas.
Materiais permitidos e recomendados
O único instrumento autorizado para a transcrição das respostas no Cartão-Resposta e na Folha de Redação é a caneta esferográfica de tinta preta, fabricada em material transparente. O Inep orienta o participante a levar duas ou mais canetas testadas na véspera. Canetas de corpo opaco ou de tinta azul e outras cores são proibidas.
Embora não seja obrigatório, o Inep recomenda levar o Cartão de Confirmação de Inscrição impresso, pois ele reúne as informações do local de prova, opção de língua estrangeira e atendimentos aprovados.
Lanches leves e medicamentos podem ser levados, desde que submetidos à vistoria do chefe de sala. A água deve ser transportada em recipiente transparente e sem componentes eletrônicos. Artigos religiosos, como burca ou quipá, e materiais próprios de acessibilidade passam por vistoria reservada pela equipe de aplicação.
Eletrônicos, envelope porta-objetos e vedações
Celulares, relógios de qualquer tipo (inteligentes ou tradicionais), fones de ouvido, calculadoras, tablets e chaves com alarme devem ter suas funções e alarmes totalmente desativados e permanecer desligados.
Antes de entrar na sala, o participante deve guardar todos os aparelhos eletrônicos, lápis, lapiseira, borracha, régua, corretivo, óculos escuros, bonés ou chapéus e anotações no envelope porta-objetos fornecido pela equipe. O envelope deve ser lacrado, identificado e mantido debaixo da carteira até a saída definitiva do prédio.
O Inep alerta que a emissão de qualquer som ou alarme por aparelhos eletrônicos durante a prova, mesmo dentro do envelope lacrado, acarreta a eliminação imediata do participante. É proibido o consumo de bebidas alcoólicas, cigarros e drogas ilícitas nos locais de exame.

https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/6.title: Why is Denmark separating ‘Western’ and ‘non-Western’ citizens?
https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/6.text:
Why is Denmark separating ‘Western’ and ‘non-Western’ citizens?
Evicted families take Denmark’s controversial ‘ghetto law’ to the Supreme Court.
Seven families from Helsingor, a coastal city north of Copenhagen, are facing their former landlord in Denmark’s Supreme Court.
In a two-day hearing that began on Friday, they are arguing they were forced from their homes because of where they, or their parents, come from.
Their leases were terminated in 2022 under a 2018 law, once known as the “ghetto law”, which targets social housing estates where more than half of residents are classed as “non-Western”. The government claims the law is aimed at integration. But rights groups have for years fought against the measures, saying they are discriminatory.
“It’s about whether the criteria regarding the tenants’ origin is neutral or not,” Eddie Khawaja, the families’ lawyer, told the news agency AFP.
So what does “non-Western” mean, and could the courts bring the law down? Here’s what you need to know:
What does ‘non-Western’ mean?
It is a statistical label that covers most of the world.
In 2020, the UN Human Rights Office said: “Statistics Denmark, under the Danish Ministry for Economic and Interior Affairs, defines ‘non-Western’ as any country outside the EU, with the exceptions of Andorra, Australia, Canada, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, New Zealand, Norway, San Marino, Switzerland, the USA, and the Vatican State.
“The effect is that ‘non-Western’ disproportionately means Denmark’s non-white, non-European ethnic populations,” it stated.
The label also covers descendants: anyone born in Denmark if neither parent is a Danish citizen born in the country.
That means a Danish citizen born and raised in Copenhagen can still be “non-Western”.
How does the law work?
Through lists.
Every December 1, the government names “parallel societies”.
These are social housing areas of at least 1,000 people where more than 50 percent are “non-Western” immigrants and descendants.
An area must also meet two of four criteria on unemployment, crime, education, and income.
Areas on the list for five years become “transformation areas”, which the government used to call “hard ghettos”.
They must cut public family housing to 40 percent by 2030 through sales, demolition or conversion.
An estate with the same social problems but fewer “non-Western” residents faces no such obligation.
Why did Denmark bring it in?
The government says the goal is integration.
The law was part of a plan called “One Denmark without Parallel Societies: No Ghettos in 2030”.
In 2021, Kaare Dybvad Bek, then interior minister, said too many non-Western foreigners in one area “increases the risk of an emergence of religious and cultural parallel societies”.
Who has been affected?
Thousands of people.
About 11,000 people across Denmark will have to leave their homes by 2030, according to tenants’ associations.
In Helsingor, the landlord Boliggarden announced in early 2020 that it would renovate 96 apartments at the Nojsomhed estate. It then terminated the tenants’ leases. Most of those tenants were of foreign origin.
“They didn’t want the estate to be labelled ‘hard ghetto’ so they wanted to forcibly move us out when we advocated for other solutions,” Riad, a 33-year-old plaintiff who did not want his family name published, told AFP.
What has the EU court said?
The law may be discriminatory, but Danish judges ultimately make the final decision about whether it violated Danish laws prohibiting ethnic discrimination.
The Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) ruled in December 2025, in cases brought by tenants from Mjolnerparken in Copenhagen and Schackenborgvaenge in Slagelse. It said nationality or country of birth alone does not determine ethnic origin, but an allegedly neutral criterion covering many origins could be linked to ethnicity.
That runs contrary to the Danish government’s position and the reasoning of the lower Danish courts in the Helsingor case, which found that the “non-Western” does not describe an ethnic group and therefore did not result in discrimination that violated Denmark’s Equal Treatment Act.
Danish judges must decide whether the “non-Western” criterion really rests on residents’ ethnic origin, the court said, and consequently, if people included in the criterion are afforded less favourable treatment.
Less favourable treatment, it noted, could include “an increased risk of early termination of their leases”.
Has Denmark changed the law?
No.
In January, Sophie Haestorp Andersen, then minister for social affairs and housing, told a parliamentary hearing that authorities must keep applying the law until the Eastern High Court rules, the Danish outlet Danske Kommuner reported.
The four-party coalition in power since June includes the Green Left (SF), which voted for the law in 2018, according to the public broadcaster DR. The party’s Jacob Mark is now minister for children, elderly affairs and housing.
What happens next?
No date has been officially set for the verdict, but reports suggest it could be handed down later this month.
If the families win, they would probably be rehoused in homes similar to the ones they had to leave.
The Mjolnerparken case is still before the Eastern High Court.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: A antipolítica como operação ideológica da direita mundial
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Cristóvão Feil
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
A operação da direita – brasileira e mundial – não se limita a simetrizar polos sob o rótulo de polarização. Ela ataca a própria dignidade da atividade política.
Ao tratar a política como sinônimo de sujeira, corrupção e inutilidade, esse discurso não apenas critica governos ou partidos. Ele desqualifica o espaço onde os conflitos sociais podem ser politizados publicamente.
A retórica antipolítica da direita, seja na versão liberal que reduz o Estado a um problema de eficiência, seja na versão radical que o apresenta como covil de corruptos, cumpre uma função precisa: substituir a deliberação sobre interesses socioeconômicos por uma cruzada moral.
O discurso anticorrupção, nesse registro, não visa aperfeiçoar instituições, mas criminalizar a própria política e construir um inimigo comum – o sistema, os políticos tradicionais – que precisa ser extirpado, sem negociação alguma.
Essa operação tem um mecanismo claro. Como mostra a análise do simulacro do discurso antissistema, a extrema direita esvazia o conceito de sistema de sua base material – classes sociais, controle dos meios de produção, disputa distributiva – e o desloca para uma nebulosa “guerra cultural”, onde a política deixa de ser o lugar da disputa por recursos e poder para se tornar um combate moral entre “povo” e “elites” abstratas.
O resultado é paradoxal. Quanto mais se denuncia a “sujeira” da política, mais se naturaliza a opressiva dominação econômica, que passa a operar fora do alcance do escrutínio público.
No Brasil, essa lógica encontrou sua expressão mais acabada no bolsonarismo, hoje, em seu ocaso.
A antipolítica de Jair Bolsonaro não foi um estilo pessoal, mas um projeto de enfraquecimento das instituições democráticas, no qual o ataque aos direitos humanos e ao Estado Democrático de Direito era apresentado como purificação moral contra a corrupção e o comunismo.
O neoliberalismo, nesse arranjo, fornece a racionalidade complementar: “Estado máximo na economia e mínimo na política”.
Quer dizer: esvaziamento da democracia para que a acumulação capitalista não seja perturbada por escolhas populares e coletivas.
A política como mais alto grau civilizacional
É aqui que a filosofia de Hannah Arendt – que nunca foi marxista – oferece o contraste mais radical. Para ela, a política não é um mal necessário, tampouco uma atividade suja a ser tolerada.
A política é a atividade humana mais elevada – diz a filósofa alemã – porque é nela que os seres humanos, na pluralidade de suas opiniões e interesses, aparecem uns aos outros como iguais e constituem um mundo comum por meio da ação (praxis) e do discurso.
Hannah Arendt distingue três esferas da “vita activa”:
1. O labor (animal laborans): a atividade que garante a sobrevivência biológica, presa à necessidade e ao ciclo repetitivo da vida.
2. O trabalho (homo faber): a fabricação de objetos duráveis que constituem o mundo material.
3. A ação (homo politicus): a atividade que se dá entre homens livres, por meio da palavra e do ato, e que cria o espaço público onde a liberdade pode e deve prevalecer.
O ponto decisivo é que Arendt considera o animal laborans e o homo faber apolíticos – e ambos tendem a denunciar a ação e o discurso políticos como “ociosidade”, julgando as atividades públicas por critérios de utilidade: para o homo faber, o que torna o mundo mais útil e produtivo; para o animal laborans, o que torna a vida mais fácil e longa.
A política, nessa perspectiva, não serve à sobrevivência nem à produção: ela existe para a liberdade, para o aparecimento de quem cada um é diante dos outros, e é justamente por isso que os espíritos utilitários a desprezam e a denunciam.
A retórica antipolítica da direita é, à luz de Arendt, a expressão de uma redução da vida humana à mera sobrevivência e à produção.
Quando se diz que “político é tudo corrupto” ou que “o importante é gerir bem os recursos”, o que se está afirmando é que a liberdade política é dispensável, que o espaço público é um estorvo, e que a sociedade deve ser organizada como uma empresa ou como um organismo que apenas precisa de eficiência e ordem. O Estado não é uma empresa que deve gerar lucros.
Arendt via nessa inversão o grande perigo da modernidade: a vitória do animal laborans sobre o homo politicus, a substituição da preocupação com o mundo comum pela preocupação com a mera vida e com o consumo.
A política, reduzida a “sujeira”, deixa de ser o lugar onde os conflitos de interesse são politizados. Isto é, transformados em questões públicas, debatidas e decididas coletivamente para se tornar um obstáculo a ser contornado por gestores, técnicos ou os famigerados salvadores da pátria.
A especificidade brasileira e a famigerada polarização
No Brasil, esse desprezo da direita e da plutocracia pela política se combina com a operação de simetrização dos polos.
A retórica de que “todos são iguais” ou “tudo é corrupção” serve para diluir a responsabilidade do campo autoritário e, ao mesmo tempo, deslegitimar o campo democrático-popular que insiste em fazer da política o lugar da disputa distributiva e da soberania.
Se a política é intrinsecamente suja, então qualquer projeto que se apresente como “gestão técnica” ou “antissistema” ganha uma aura de pureza – mesmo que, na prática, governe para os mais ricos e ataque os direitos fundamentais.
A antipolítica da direita não é, portanto, uma crítica à má política em nome de uma boa política. É uma crítica à política enquanto tal, feita a partir de uma matriz utilitária que não reconhece na ação coletiva nenhum valor em si mesma.
É a recusa de Arendt: a recusa de que os seres humanos, na pluralidade de suas opiniões, possam constituir um mundo comum por meio da palavra e do ato.
Hannah Arendt nos ajuda a nomear o que está em jogo hoje, seja no Brasil ou no mundo todo.
Quando a direita trata a política como sujeira, ela não está apenas fazendo retórica eleitoral. Está desqualificando o único espaço em que a desigualdade e a dominação podem ser contestadas publicamente.
A política, para Arendt, é o indicativo de que alcançamos o mais alto grau civilizacional porque é nela que a liberdade se torna realidade visível.
Desprezar a política como “coisa de político” é, no limite, aceitar que a vida coletiva seja reduzida à administração da sobrevivência e à produção de coisas – um mundo sem espaço para o aparecimento da liberdade. Portanto, um mundo onde a luta de classes não pode nem sequer ser nomeada.
*Cristóvão Feil é sociólogo.
*Este é um artigo de opinião e não necessariamente representa a linha editorial do Brasil de Fato.

Les cookies et technologies similaires que nous utilisons sur Mediapart sont de différentes natures et nous permettent de poursuivre différentes finalités. 
Certains sont nécessaires au fonctionnement du site et de l’application mobile (vous ne pouvez pas les refuser). D’autres sont optionnels mais contribuent à faciliter votre expérience de lecteur ou de lectrice et d’une certaine façon à soutenir Mediapart. Vous pouvez les refuser ou les accepter ci-dessous, selon leurs finalités. 
Acceptez-vous que Mediapart utilise des cookies ou technologies similaires pour les finalités suivantes ? 
Vous pouvez faire votre choix, pour chaque catégorie, en activant ou désactivant le bouton interrupteur.
                    
                            
                                Nécessaires au fonctionnement
du site ou de l’application
                            Connexion des abonné·es, mesure d’audience anonymisée, envoi des notifications push, suivi des pannes, mise en avant de nos services : ces outils sont nécessaires au suivi de l’activité de nos services et à leur bon fonctionnement.
                                    Voici les différents cookies et technologies similaires compris dans cette catégorie :
                                                                                    - Cookies d’authentification : connexion des abonné·es.
- Batch (uniquement sur l’application) : envoi de notifications push et de messages in-app.
- Affichage de contenus éditoriaux multimédias : vidéos (YouTube, Dailymotion, Vimeo, INA), réseaux sociaux (Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Twitter), documents (Scribd, Document Cloud, Slideshare), sons (SoundCloud, Spotify, Deezer), cartes (Google Maps, Mapbox, CartoDB, uMap), infographies (Highcharts, GitHub, Datawrapper, Flourish, Infogram, ThingLink, jQuery, Google Fonts, Bootstrap), live blogs (24liveblog, CoverItLive), aide à l’intégration de média dans les publications Journal et Club (Embedly).
- Datadog (uniquement sur le site web) : indicateurs techniques et équilibrage de charge.
- Firebase Cloud Messaging (uniquement sur l’application) : nécessaire au fonctionnement des notifications push sur Android.
- Microsoft App Center (uniquement sur l’application) : système de mise à jour et de suivi des pannes de l’application.
- Piano : mesure d’audience anonymisée
- Selligent (uniquement sur le site web) : communication avec l’abonné·e, mise en avant des services, offres et avantages.
- Typeform : questionnaires facultatifs pour recueillir les avis des lecteurs sur nos produits numériques.
                                                    
                                            
                            
                            Ces outils nous permettent de recueillir des statistiques de fréquentation du site et de l’application mobile pour comprendre les usages, détecter d’éventuels problèmes et optimiser l’ergonomie de nos produits.
                                    Voici les outils tiers compris dans cette catégorie :
                                                                                    - Batch (uniquement sur le site web) : mesure d’audience reliée à l’identifiant d’abonné·e.
- CrazyEggs (uniquement sur le site web) : analyse de parcours client.
- Nonli (uniquement sur le site web) : permet à notre équipe des réseaux sociaux de publier les contenus Mediapart sur les réseaux sociaux.
- Piano : mesure d’audience reliée à l’identifiant d’abonné·e.
- Qiota (uniquement sur le site web) : gestion du système de datawall.
                                                    
                                            
                            
                            Il n’y a pas de publicité sur Mediapart. Mais nous faisons la promotion de nos contenus et services sur d’autres sites et réseaux sociaux. Pour cela, nous utilisons les technologies mises à disposition par certains acteurs publicitaires.
                                    Voici les outils tiers compris dans cette catégorie :
                                                                                    - Facebook (uniquement sur le site web) : ciblage d’audience sur les réseaux sociaux pour faire la promotion de Mediapart.
                                                    
                                            
                            
                                Gestion de l’accès aux contenus
                            Nous utilisons le service Qiota d’Opper Marketing Suite pour configurer l’activation d’un datawall sur certains de nos contenus (uniquement sur le site web). Ce dispositif destiné aux utilisateur·ices non abonné·es requiert la saisie d’une adresse email pour accéder aux contenus concernés. En fournissant cette information, l’utilisateur consent à sa collecte, son stockage et son utilisation à des fins statistiques. Conformément à la réglementation en vigueur, les utilisateurs disposent d’un droit d’accès, de rectification et de suppression de leurs données, qu’ils peuvent exercer en contactant dpo@opper.io.

https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/n.title: Kenyan doomsday sect leader jailed for 200 years for murder of 190 children
https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/n.author: Carlos Mureithi in Nairobi and agencies
https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/n.text:
The leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult in one of the world’s worst cult disasters in recent history.
The sentence, comprising 100 years for murder by starvation and 100 years by direct homicide, came two weeks after the court in Kenya’s coastal city of Mombasa found the cult leader guilty of the crimes.
Prosecutors said Paul Mackenzie and his Good News International church ran a Christian doomsday sect whose members were ordered to starve themselves and their children to death to go to heaven before the world ended.
His accomplices threatened and beat victims to ensure they followed his orders. The emaciated bodies were found scattered in shallow graves and dumped in latrines. Some had been buried alive.
Mackenzie was arrested in 2023 after police received a tipoff, and weeks later authorities began uncovering bodies in shallow graves in the Shakahola forest near the coast in south-eastern Kenya.
In total, more than 400 bodies have been recovered. Many were severely decomposed and only 26 could be identified.
Mackenzie denied murder charges, saying he did not force the victims to starve, but the court rejected that argument.
The Shakahola tragedy has gripped Kenya since the discovery of mass graves in the forest more than three years ago.
It raised questions about how Mackenzie was able to continue operating despite being on the radar of the authorities since 2017, when police searched his premises.
In 2019, authorities shut down Mackenzie’s church and he relocated to the Shakahola forest, police said.
The case has also led to calls for tougher oversight of churches and other religious organisations in a country where religious faith plays a prominent role in public life.
Mackenzie, a former taxi driver, forbade cult members from sending their children to school and from going to hospital when they were ill, describing such institutions as satanic.
Cult members lived in makeshift homes of polythene sheeting and thatch that Mackenzie divided into areas with biblical names such as Jerusalem and Judea.
The plight of his followers began to emerge in March 2023, when a man told police his brother and wife had starved their children to death in the forest on Mackenzie’s orders.
Mackenzie was arrested but released on bail, after which relatives said he brought forward the date on which he told his followers the world would end. Police rearrested him and started combing through the forest more systematically and began exhuming mass graves.
Last month’s judgment covered 191 deaths while investigations into more than 200 other deaths are continuing.
Justice Diana Kavedza-Mochache said in a hearing lasting more than eight hours that in some cases children were isolated and denied food while their parents watched.
Mackenzie faces other charges over the forest deaths, including those of terrorism, which he has denied.
Prosecutors said that while he was in detention he also directed the deaths of 52 people in Kwa Binzaro village, about 18 miles from Shakahola. Mackenzie has pleaded not guilty in that case.
Reuters contributed reporting

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/colunist.title: Como será o amanhã?
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/colunist.author: Boletim Ponto
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/colunist.text:
Olá! Todos jogam as cartas agora de olho nos próximos quatro anos.
.O golpe está aí. Sem precisar fugir para Miami, a Faria Lima se declarou líder da oposição no Brasil. E mesmo sem se autoproclamar presidente, o mercado financeiro quer usurpar o resultado das eleições e tomar as decisões sobre o futuro do país. Depois de abraçar sem vergonha a candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro e já imaginar futuros ministros e decretos, a Faria Lima foi atropelada pelo resultado das urnas junto com o bolsonarismo. A primeira demonstração de que não ia aceitar o resultado veio logo no dia seguinte, quando derrubou a bolsa e inflacionou o dólar, apoiada pelo terrorismo da mídia. Na prática, o mercado quer que Lula adote o projeto derrotado nas urnas. Nesta semana, o mercado entrou em polvorosa pela simples possibilidade de Lula se encontrar com o economista André Lara Resende e ouvir sua proposta para baixar a taxa de juros. A formulação de Resende, como analisa Luis Nassif, não mexe no modelo macroeconômico vigente desde o Plano Real. Mesmo assim, caiu como uma bomba porque, afinal, o autor é um economista liberal, não-marxista, não-petista, um dos pais do Plano Real, dizendo que existem outros caminhos para baixar os juros, que não sejam mais austeridade e corte de gastos. O Exército da Faria Lima ganhou o reforço de Gabriel Galípolo. O Banco Central não só interrompeu a queda da taxa, como justificou com um comunicado duro que dá eco a todas as preocupações do mercado, endossando as previsões de alta da inflação e insinuando a necessidade de cortes. Completando a tabelinha, o mercado já apresentou sua pauta: manter a Selic em 13,75% por todo o próximo semestre. A lista de exigências dos sequestradores inclui ainda que Lula anuncie logo o novo Ministro da Fazenda — mais motivo de pânico ou alívio — e que se pronuncie assumindo compromissos com o corte de gastos. Mas, segundo Julia Duailibi, o presidente deve frustrar tanto quem quer subordinação ao mercado quanto quem espera medidas radicais. Lula não dará carta branca ao mercado, mas também não vai abrir mão das promessas de campanha. O provável ajuste deve seguir em busca do centro da meta de superávit, manter o gatilho que exclui determinadas receitas do cálculo de gastos, aumentar a flexibilidade para bloquear ou contingenciar, cortar gastos tributários e fazer um pente-fino nas despesas.
.Estamos contratando. Na prática, a transição para o novo governo já começou. A estratégia de Lula para fechar o ano é botar o pé no acelerador antes que a avalanche de deputados e senadores do PL assumam seus mandatos. Foi assim que o presidente conseguiu uma sequência de vitórias que contribuíram não só para sua reeleição, mas também para dar o tom do novo mandato: o fim da escala 6×1, a ampliação do teto dos MEIs e a PEC da Segurança Pública. Mais do que vencer, a estratégia governista visa cooptar os parlamentares do Centrão e parte da direita para a agenda governista, com forte apelo popular, enfraquecendo e desarticulando a oposição. Porém, as relações com o Congresso não prometem ser fáceis nos próximos anos. Além do toma-lá-dá-cá das emendas, que deve continuar, o Planalto já iniciou as negociações para contemplar a base aliada com ministérios, convertendo cargos em votos, tarefa que, por enquanto, ficará com Edinho Silva, presidente do PT. O problema é que a governabilidade não é a única variável a ser levada em conta na indicação de ministros, pois estes definirão também os rumos programáticos do governo. Evidentemente, a pasta mais cotada é a da Fazenda, para a qual têm sido cogitados nomes como o atual ministro Dario Durigan, o governador do Piauí Rafael Fonteles, e o vice-presidente Geraldo Alckmin, também cotado para o novo Ministério da Segurança Pública. Outro velho dilema é quem assumirá a Defesa, cargo tradicionalmente entregue a alguém próximo aos generais e distante da esquerda e que costuma sofrer com o fogo amigo petista, como os favoritos do momento. Além disso, na relação do Planalto com o Congresso, tudo dependerá de quem comandará as presidências da Câmara e do Senado a partir de fevereiro. Por ora, de olho nas próprias reeleições, Hugo Motta e Davi Alcolumbre têm trabalhado em colaboração com o governo. Mas ambos também acenam para a oposição, buscando apoio da direita, como fez Alcolumbre ao defender o mandato de senador Flávio Bolsonaro, que passou ao trabalho remoto. Por sua vez, o bolsonarismo já escolheu seu candidato para enfrentar Alcolumbre, o senador Rogério Marinho, cuja pauta central deve ser (surpresa!) a anistia aos golpistas de 8 de janeiro. Mas, além de sofrer com o rescaldo da fuga de Flávio Bolsonaro e da derrota dos Republicanos nos Estados Unidos, Marinho terá que pacificar as relações com a direita tradicional, representada pela candidatura de Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) à presidência do Senado. E, enquanto o bolsonarismo afunda, Tarcísio de Freitas arruma a casa e aguarda, sabendo que o tempo está a seu favor.
.Ponto Final: nossas recomendações.
.‘Voto raivoso’: derrota de Trump reflete insatisfação com custo de vida, não paixão pelos democratas. No Brasil de Fato, Stephanie Weatherbee analisa a “onda azul” estadunidense.
.Europa: o antissistema agora é a juventude. Enquanto a esquerda vai às ruas pelas mãos da juventude, a extrema direita aposta na repressão. No Outras Palavras.
.Projetos de mineradora financiados pelo Master afetam 127 áreas protegidas. O Repórter Brasil mostra como os projetos da 3D Minerals afetam terras indígenas, territórios quilombolas, unidades de conservação e assentamentos.
.A redução da maioridade penal pode reduzir crimes? O que dizem os dados. O Notícia Preta mostra que os dados disponíveis contrariam as teses da direita.
.‘O futebol existe há um século sem as bets’: cientista política defende veto às apostas no STF. No Brasil de Fato, Rosemary Segurado contesta o argumento dos clubes sobre crise financeira.
.Fandoms em ação: estudo mostra como os fãs de cultura pop ajudaram na reeleição de Lula. Como fãs de artistas como Beyoncé, Taylor Swift, Olivia Rodrigo, Lady Gaga, Blackpink e BTS engajaram-se nas eleições. No The Conversation.
.‘Cometerra’, o romance argentino perseguido pelo governo Milei. O Opera Mundi apresenta o livro de Dolores Reyes que trata de feminicídio por meio de ficção.
